status: predeclared empirical qualification envelope; not a certified OCCT error bound; not production admission
W: max(1 mm, absolute coordinate of all transformed requested endpoints and centers)
L: max(1 mm, local boundary endpoint bounding-box diagonal, all canonical radii)
P: analytic perimeter of the ideal line/circle boundary
A: midpoint of independent analytic area enclosure
comparison: distance(native local-reference mass, independent analytic interval) <= corresponding E; numerical interval/endpoint-gap/parameter-conversion allowances belong to the independent analytic interval
rules: Apply the identical formula to every case and retain every failure.
Do not fit constants to outcomes, silently remove difficult supported fixtures, or widen a case allowance.
Reference calculations that are merely high-precision approximations must be labeled approximate and cannot substitute for later certified production intervals.
Passing this formula does not certify identity, contacts, trim, stored tolerance, native validity, or arbitrary kernels/platforms. Those remain independent gates.
Boundary cases may be honest unsupported-domain/native-postflight rejections, never reported as successful geometry.
rationale: Predeclared roundoff-scaled engineering comparison criterion: an operation-count factor on local squared scale, a world-coordinate times perimeter sensitivity term, and height/area propagation for volume. The coefficients are conservative proposed qualification constants, not an analytical bound on proprietary/native mass integration implementation.
